name: stackedbarchart
description: A modern, animated, interactive stacked bar chart for Mendix 10+ with per-element colouring, click-to-edit menus, per-bar add buttons, drag & drop between bars and configurable tooltips.

_dependencyNotes.@mendix/pluggable-widgets-tools: Pinned to 10.x on purpose. Version 11 targets `mendix ^11.8.0` and React 19, which would make the widget Mendix 11 only. The 10.24 line builds a widget that runs on Mendix 10.24 and on Mendix 11.
_dependencyNotes.big.js: Held at 6.x to match the runtime. big.js is an external in the web build, supplied by the Mendix client, and both toolchain lines pin ^6.0.2. Moving to 7 would type against a version the platform does not ship.
_dependencyNotes.react: Pinned via overrides at 18.2.0, the version the Mendix 10 client provides.
